column1: TRANSLATION SHEET - CORWADO TELEGRAM BOT MESSAGES (ENGLISH TO JUBA ARABIC)
Hello Philip, thank you for helping with this! Here is how this sheet works:
1. Please fill in the LAST column, "juba_arabic_translation", with the Juba Arabic version of each message in the "english_text" column.

2. Spelling: Juba Arabic does not have one official/standard spelling, so please do not worry about "correct" spelling. Just write it the way it sounds when spoken, using the same English letters (A, B, C...) that this sheet is written in.

3. Some messages have a word inside curly braces, like {name} or {crop} or {price}. These are placeholders -- the computer automatically swaps them for real information (a real name, a real crop, a real price, etc.) before the message is sent. You must copy these words EXACTLY as they appear, curly braces and all, into your translation -- do NOT translate the word inside the braces itself. The "placeholder_note" column explains what each one means in plain language.

4. Some messages also contain command words in capital letters, like REGISTER, BOUNDARY, YES, NO, STAFF, PRICE, SKIP, DONE. These are words the farmer has to type back to the bot exactly as shown, so please leave these capitalized English words as they are too -- do not translate them.

5. If a message doesn't translate naturally into Juba Arabic, or you're simply not sure about one, that is totally fine -- just leave that row's last column blank and move on to the next one. No pressure to force a translation.

6. Please don't change the "key" column (first column) or reorder the rows -- that column is just an internal label so the message can be matched back up in the system later. You don't need to do anything with it.
7. When you're done, please save/send the file back in the same format (Excel or CSV is fine).
Thank you very much for your help with this!
